title: Chess scene: Toledo dominates Cavite, Cagayan in Wesley So Cup

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Toledo Xignex Trojans swept the Cavite Spartans and Cagayan Kings in back-to-back matches in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup on Saturday, October 3. The Trojans bounced back from a rough start and found their winning form. They first dismantled Cavite, 18-3, before overwhelming Cagayan, 17-4, as the Wesley So Cup competition heated up. The twin victories lifted Toledo to second place in the Omega Division with a 3-1 win-loss record. They were just behind the unbeaten Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos, who remain perfect at 4-0.
